```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

# Point to the DGE_filtered directory
data_dir <- "./DGE_filtered/"

# Load the three components
counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx    = file.path(data_dir, "count_matrix.mtx"),
  cells  = file.path(data_dir, "cell_metadata.csv"),
  features = file.path(data_dir, "all_genes.csv"),
  cell.column = 1,       # column in cell_metadata.csv with cell barcodes
  feature.column = 2,    # column in all_genes.csv with gene symbols (col 1 = gene_id, col 2 = gene_name)
  cell.sep = ",",
  feature.sep = ",",
  skip.cell = 1,         # skip header row
  skip.feature = 1,
  mtx.transpose = TRUE   # Parse MTX is genes x cells, Seurat expects cells x genes
)

# Create Seurat object
sample <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  project = "ParseSeq",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)
```

```{r}
meta <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "cell_metadata.csv"), row.names = 1)

# Subset to cells retained in the Seurat object
meta <- meta[colnames(sample), ]
sample <- AddMetaData(sample, metadata = meta)
```

```{r}
# Prepare PRTB assay for dimensionality reduction: 
# Normalize data, find variable features and center data.
DefaultAssay(object = sample) <- 'PRTB'

# Use variable features from RNA assay.
VariableFeatures(object = sample) <- VariableFeatures(object = sample[["RNA"]])
sample <- ScaleData(object = sample, do.scale = F, do.center = T)

# Run PCA to reduce the dimensionality of the data.
sample <- RunPCA(object = sample, reduction.key = 'prtbpca', reduction.name = 'prtbpca')

# Run UMAP to visualize clustering in 2-D.
sample <- RunUMAP(
  object = sample, 
  dims = 1:30, 
  reduction = 'prtbpca', 
  reduction.key = 'prtbumap', 
  reduction.name = 'prtbumap')
```

### Additional analyses

```{r}
# KD classification rate (ko_rate)
ko_rate <- sample@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(PERTURB != "NT") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PERTURB) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells  = dplyr::n(),
    n_kd     = sum(mixscape_class.global == "KD"),
    kd_rate  = n_kd / n_cells
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(kd_rate))

print(ko_rate)
```

```{r}
# Transcriptional Distance from NT in PRTB PCA Space

# Extract PRTB PCA embeddings from full object
pca_embed <- Embeddings(sample, "prtbpca")[, 1:30]
meta      <- sample@meta.data

# NT centroid
ntc_centroid <- pca_embed[meta$mixscape_class.global == "NT", ] %>%
  colMeans()

# Per-perturbation centroid distance (KD cells only)
perturbations <- levels(sample$PERTURB)
perturbations <- perturbations[perturbations != "NT"]

effect_sizes <- lapply(perturbations, function(pert) {
  cells_pert <- rownames(meta)[meta$PERTURB == pert & meta$mixscape_class.global == "KD"]
  if (length(cells_pert) < 5) return(NULL)
  pert_centroid <- colMeans(pca_embed[cells_pert, , drop = FALSE])
  dist_val      <- sqrt(sum((pert_centroid - ntc_centroid)^2))
  data.frame(PERTURB = pert, n_kd_cells = length(cells_pert), prtb_pc_distance = dist_val)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(desc(prtb_pc_distance))

print(effect_sizes)
```

```{r}
# Pseudobulk DE with DESeq2

library(DESeq2)

# Work from sub (KD + NT cells only, post-Mixscape)
DefaultAssay(sub) <- "RNA"

# Function to run DESeq2 for one perturbation vs NT
run_deseq2_vs_nt <- function(seurat_obj, pert_name, n_pseudoreps = 3) {
  
  cells_pert <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[
    seurat_obj$PERTURB == pert_name & seurat_obj$mixscape_class.global == "KD"
  ]
  cells_nt <- rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data)[
    seurat_obj$mixscape_class.global == "NT"
  ]
  
  if (length(cells_pert) < 10) {
    message("Skipping ", pert_name, ": too few KD cells")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Assign pseudo-replicate labels by randomly splitting cells
  set.seed(42)
  pert_rep <- sample(1:n_pseudoreps, length(cells_pert), replace = TRUE)
  nt_rep   <- sample(1:n_pseudoreps, length(cells_nt),   replace = TRUE)
  
  # Build count matrix
  counts_pert <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts")[, cells_pert]
  counts_nt   <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "counts")[, cells_nt]
  
  # Aggregate by pseudo-replicate (pseudobulk)
  pb_pert <- sapply(1:n_pseudoreps, function(r) rowSums(counts_pert[, pert_rep == r, drop = FALSE]))
  pb_nt   <- sapply(1:n_pseudoreps, function(r) rowSums(counts_nt[,   nt_rep   == r, drop = FALSE]))
  
  colnames(pb_pert) <- paste0(pert_name, "_rep", 1:n_pseudoreps)
  colnames(pb_nt)   <- paste0("NT_rep",           1:n_pseudoreps)
  
  pb_mat  <- cbind(pb_pert, pb_nt)
  col_data <- data.frame(
    condition = factor(c(rep("KD", n_pseudoreps), rep("NT", n_pseudoreps)),
                       levels = c("NT", "KD")),
    row.names = colnames(pb_mat)
  )
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(pb_mat, colData = col_data, design = ~condition)
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]   # filter lowly expressed genes
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
  
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "KD", "NT"), 
                 independentFiltering = TRUE, alpha = 0.05) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    arrange(padj)
  
  return(res)
}

# Run for all perturbations
perturbations <- levels(sub@meta.data$PERTURB)
perturbations <- perturbations[perturbations != "NT"]

de_results <- list()
for (pert in perturbations) {
  message("Running DESeq2 for: ", pert)
  de_results[[pert]] <- run_deseq2_vs_nt(sub, pert)
}
```

```{r}
mean_lfc <- lapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  sig <- res %>% filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)
  data.frame(
    PERTURB       = pert,
    n_sig_genes   = nrow(sig),
    mean_abs_lfc  = ifelse(nrow(sig) > 0, mean(abs(sig$log2FoldChange)), NA)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abs_lfc))

print(mean_lfc)
```

```{r}
# Join all three metrics

  left_join(effect_sizes, by = "PERTURB") %>%
  left_join(mean_lfc,     by = "PERTURB") %>%
  mutate(
    type = ifelse(grepl("_Enh", PERTURB), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD")

                            y = prtb_pc_distance, fill = type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x    = NULL,
    y    = "Transcriptional distance from NT\n(PRTB PCA space)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
n_boot <- 1000

boot_distances <- lapply(perturbations, function(pert) {
  cells_pert <- rownames(meta)[meta$PERTURB == pert & meta$mixscape_class.global == "KD"]
  if (length(cells_pert) < 5) return(NULL)
  boot_dist <- replicate(n_boot, {
    boot_cells <- sample(cells_pert, replace = TRUE)
    centroid   <- colMeans(pca_embed[boot_cells, , drop = FALSE])
    sqrt(sum((centroid - ntc_centroid)^2))
  })
  data.frame(PERTURB = pert, 
             ci_low  = quantile(boot_dist, 0.025),
             ci_high = quantile(boot_dist, 0.975))
}) %>% bind_rows()

effect_sizes <- effect_sizes %>% left_join(boot_distances, by = "PERTURB")
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DESeq2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(decoupleR)
library(pheatmap)
library(ArchR)
library(conflicted)
```

```{r}
# Load gene sets: Hallmark + GO Biological Process
msig_h  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  split(f = .$gs_name) %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$gene_symbol)

msig_go <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  split(f = .$gs_name) %>%
  lapply(function(x) x$gene_symbol)

gene_sets <- c(msig_h, msig_go)

# Run fgsea per perturbation
gsea_results <- lapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  
  # Ranked vector: log2FC, named by gene, NAs removed
  ranked <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange), !is.na(padj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(log2FoldChange))
  
  ranks <- setNames(ranked$log2FoldChange, ranked$gene)
  
  set.seed(42)
  fgseaRes <- fgsea(pathways = gene_sets,
                    stats    = ranks,
                    minSize  = 15,
                    maxSize  = 500,
                    nPerm    = 1000) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)
  
  fgseaRes$PERTURB <- pert
  return(fgseaRes)
})
names(gsea_results) <- names(de_results)

saveRDS(gsea_results, "gsea_results.rds")

# Summary dotplot — top 5 Hallmark pathways per perturbation
hallmark_summary <- lapply(names(gsea_results), function(pert) {
  res <- gsea_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  res %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("^HALLMARK", pathway), padj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(padj, n = 5) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(PERTURB = pert)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
# Cross-Perturbation Transcriptional Similarity
library(Matrix)

# Build LFC matrix: genes x perturbations
all_genes <- Reduce(dplyr::union, lapply(de_results, function(x) if (!is.null(x)) x$gene))

lfc_matrix <- sapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(rep(NA, length(all_genes)))
  lfc <- setNames(res$log2FoldChange, res$gene)
  lfc[all_genes]   # NA for genes not tested
})
rownames(lfc_matrix) <- all_genes

# Replace NAs with 0 for distance calculation
lfc_matrix[is.na(lfc_matrix)] <- 0

# Cosine similarity function
cosine_sim <- function(mat) {
  mat_norm <- sweep(mat, 2, sqrt(colSums(mat^2)), "/")
  t(mat_norm) %*% mat_norm
}

sim_matrix <- cosine_sim(lfc_matrix)

# Annotation: Gene KD vs Enhancer KD
annot_col <- data.frame(
  Type = ifelse(grepl("_Enh", colnames(sim_matrix)), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD"),
  row.names = colnames(sim_matrix)
)

annot_colors <- list(Type = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2"))

pdf("./cross_perturbation_similarity.pdf", width = 7, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
pheatmap(sim_matrix,
         color            = paletteContinuous("solarExtra"),
         annotation_col   = annot_col,
         annotation_colors = annot_colors,
         border_color     = NA,
         fontsize         = 8,
         main             = "Cross-perturbation transcriptional similarity")
dev.off()

```

```{r}
### Enhancer-to-Gene Target Validation

# Define your predicted enhancer -> gene pairs from scE2G/Hi-C
# Edit this to match your actual predictions
enh_gene_pairs <- data.frame(
  enhancer   = c("ADAMTS7_Enh", "BMP1_Enh", "CFDP1_Enh", "COL4A1_Enh",
                 "MAT2A_Enh",   "MRAS_Enh", "MYO9B_Enh", "TWIST1_Enh"),
  target     = c("ADAMTS7",     "BMP1",     "CFDP1",     "COL4A1",
                 "MAT2A",       "MRAS",     "MYO9B",     "TWIST1")
)

# For each enhancer KD, get rank of predicted target in DE list
target_ranks <- lapply(1:nrow(enh_gene_pairs), function(i) {
  enh    <- enh_gene_pairs$enhancer[i]
  target <- enh_gene_pairs$target[i]
  res    <- de_results[[enh]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  
  # Rank by significance (ascending padj)
  res_ranked <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rank = dplyr::row_number(), n_genes = dplyr::n())
  
  target_row <- res_ranked %>% dplyr::filter(gene == target)
  
  data.frame(
    enhancer      = enh,
    target        = target,
    target_rank   = ifelse(nrow(target_row) > 0, target_row$rank,    NA),
    n_genes_tested = ifelse(nrow(target_row) > 0, target_row$n_genes, NA),
    target_lfc    = ifelse(nrow(target_row) > 0, target_row$log2FoldChange, NA),
    target_padj   = ifelse(nrow(target_row) > 0, target_row$padj, NA),
    percentile    = ifelse(nrow(target_row) > 0, 
                           1 - (target_row$rank / target_row$n_genes), NA)
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

print(target_ranks)

# Permutation null: for each enhancer KD, what rank would a random gene get?
set.seed(42)
n_perm <- 1000

perm_ranks <- lapply(enh_gene_pairs$enhancer, function(enh) {
  res <- de_results[[enh]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  res_ranked <- res %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>% dplyr::arrange(padj)
  sample(1:nrow(res_ranked), n_perm, replace = TRUE)
}) 
names(perm_ranks) <- enh_gene_pairs$enhancer

# Plot observed rank vs null distribution
pdf("./enhancer_target_rank_validation.pdf", width = 6, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
par(mfrow = c(2, 4), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1))
for (i in 1:nrow(enh_gene_pairs)) {
  enh  <- enh_gene_pairs$enhancer[i]
  obs  <- target_ranks$target_rank[target_ranks$enhancer == enh]
  null <- perm_ranks[[enh]]
  if (is.null(null) || is.na(obs)) next
  hist(null, breaks = 30, col = "grey80", border = NA,
       main = enh, xlab = "Rank", cex.main = 0.8)
  abline(v = obs, col = "red", lwd = 2)
}
dev.off()
```

# TF Motif / Regulon Enrichment per Perturbation
```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)

# Load TF target gene sets from MSigDB C3 (motif gene sets)
msig_tf <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C3", subcategory = "TFT:GTRD") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

tf_enrichment <- lapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  
  sig_genes <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05, log2FoldChange < -0.25) %>%  # downregulated
    dplyr::pull(gene)
  
  if (length(sig_genes) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  universe <- res$gene
  
  enrich_res <- enricher(
    gene         = sig_genes,
    universe     = universe,
    TERM2GENE    = msig_tf,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2
  )
  
  if (is.null(enrich_res)) return(NULL)
  
  enrich_res@result %>%
    dplyr::mutate(PERTURB = pert) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Dotplot
pdf("./tf_motif_enrichment.pdf", width = 10, height = 8, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(tf_enrichment, aes(x = PERTURB, y = Description, 
                           size = -log10(p.adjust), color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "TF motif enrichment (downregulated genes)")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Wilcoxon test per program per perturbation vs NT
# (cell-level is acceptable here since we're testing usage scores, not expression)
nt_usage <- sub@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(mixscape_class.global == "NT") %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(cnmf_cols))

cnmf_stats <- lapply(all_perts, function(pert) {
  pert_usage <- sub@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(PERTURB == pert, mixscape_class.global == "KD") %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(cnmf_cols))
  
  if (nrow(pert_usage) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  lapply(cnmf_cols, function(prog) {
    wt <- wilcox.test(pert_usage[[prog]], nt_usage[[prog]])
    data.frame(
      PERTURB  = pert,
      program  = prog,
      p.value  = wt$p.value,
      mean_kd  = mean(pert_usage[[prog]], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_nt  = mean(nt_usage[[prog]],  na.rm = TRUE),
      delta    = mean(pert_usage[[prog]], na.rm = TRUE) - mean(nt_usage[[prog]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

# Dotplot of enriched programs
sig_cnmf <- cnmf_stats %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05)

pdf("./cNMF/cnmf_program_dotplot.pdf", width = 7, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(sig_cnmf, aes(x = PERTURB, y = program, size = -log10(padj), color = delta)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Δ usage\n(KD - NT)", size = "-log10(padj)")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#The reference figure uses ComplexHeatmap which gives far more control over aesthetics than pheatmap. Here's the code to replicate that style:
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# Build summary matrix (perturbations x programs)
cnmf_summary <- sub@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(mixscape_class.global == "KD") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PERTURB) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(cnmf_cols_clean), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("PERTURB") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Rename columns to biological labels
colnames(cnmf_summary) <- bio_labels[colnames(cnmf_summary)]

# Scale across perturbations (z-score per program)
cnmf_scaled <- scale(cnmf_summary)

# Color scale: white to red
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(min(cnmf_scaled, na.rm = TRUE), 0, max(cnmf_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("white", "white", "red")
)

# Top annotation: Gene KD vs Enhancer KD
type_vec <- ifelse(grepl("_Enh", rownames(cnmf_scaled)), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD")
top_annot <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Type = type_vec,
  col  = list(Type = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2")),
  annotation_label = "Type",
  simple_anno_size = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = TRUE,
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  annotation_name_side = "left"
)

# Draw heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  t(cnmf_scaled),                        # programs x perturbations
  name                  = "Program\ngene z score",
  col                   = col_fun,
  top_annotation        = top_annot,
  cluster_rows          = TRUE,
  cluster_columns       = TRUE,
  show_row_dend         = FALSE,          # clean — no dendrograms
  show_column_dend      = FALSE,
  row_names_side        = "left",
  row_names_gp          = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp       = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_rot      = 45,
  border                = FALSE,
  rect_gp               = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),  # thin white grid lines
  heatmap_legend_param  = list(
    title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "plain"),
    labels_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(3, "cm"),
    border        = NA
  )
)
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)

# ── SHARED DEFINITIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  "cNMF_6" = "Interferon-stimulated SMC"
)

program_order <- unname(bio_labels[cnmf_ids_clean])

# ── PANEL 1: Program gene specificity scores ──────────────────────────────────

top_genes_list <- lapply(cnmf_ids_clean, function(prog) {
  names(sort(cnmf_scores_mat[prog, ], decreasing = TRUE))[1:5]
})
names(top_genes_list) <- cnmf_ids_clean
top_genes       <- unique(unlist(top_genes_list))
top_genes_valid <- top_genes[top_genes %in% colnames(cnmf_scores_mat)]
message(length(top_genes_valid), " / ", length(top_genes), " genes found")

panel1_mat <- cnmf_scores_mat[cnmf_ids_clean, top_genes_valid]
rownames(panel1_mat) <- bio_labels[rownames(panel1_mat)]

panel1_scaled <- t(scale(t(panel1_mat)))
panel1_scaled[is.na(panel1_scaled)]    <- 0
panel1_scaled[panel1_scaled < 0]       <- 0

col_fun1 <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, max(panel1_scaled, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("white", "red")
)

ht1 <- Heatmap(
  panel1_scaled,
  name                 = "Program gene\nz score",
  col                  = col_fun1,
  cluster_rows         = TRUE,
  cluster_columns      = FALSE,
  show_row_dend        = FALSE,
  show_column_dend     = FALSE,
  row_names_side       = "left",
  column_names_side    = "bottom",
  row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot     = 45,
  border               = FALSE,
  rect_gp              = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "plain"),
    labels_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(2.5, "cm"),
    border        = NA
  )
)

# ── PANEL 2: TF motif enrichment per program ──────────────────────────────────

msig_tf <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C3", subcategory = "TFT:GTRD") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

tf_motif_enrichment <- lapply(cnmf_ids_clean, function(prog) {
  top100 <- names(sort(cnmf_scores_mat[prog, ], decreasing = TRUE))[1:100]
  top100 <- top100[top100 %in% colnames(cnmf_scores_mat)]

  res <- enricher(
    gene         = top100,
    universe     = colnames(cnmf_scores_mat),
    TERM2GENE    = msig_tf,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    qvalueCutoff = 1
  )
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  res@result %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      program   = prog,
      neg_log10 = -log10(p.adjust + 1e-10)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(program, Description, neg_log10)
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

top_motifs <- tf_motif_enrichment %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Description) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(max_score = max(neg_log10)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(max_score, n = 20) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Description)

panel2_mat <- tf_motif_enrichment %>%
  dplyr::filter(Description %in% top_motifs) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Description, values_from = neg_log10, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("program") %>%
  as.matrix()

panel2_mat <- panel2_mat[cnmf_ids_clean[cnmf_ids_clean %in% rownames(panel2_mat)], ]
rownames(panel2_mat) <- bio_labels[rownames(panel2_mat)]
colnames(panel2_mat) <- gsub("_TARGET_GENES|GTRD_", "", colnames(panel2_mat))

# Clean NAs/Infs
panel2_mat[is.na(panel2_mat)]       <- 0
panel2_mat[is.infinite(panel2_mat)] <- 0

col_fun2 <- colorRamp2(
  c(0, max(panel2_mat, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("white", "red")
)

ht2 <- Heatmap(
  panel2_mat,
  name                 = "-log10(FDR)",
  col                  = col_fun2,
  cluster_rows         = FALSE,
  cluster_columns      = TRUE,
  show_row_dend        = FALSE,
  show_column_dend     = FALSE,
  show_row_names       = FALSE,
  column_names_side    = "bottom",
  column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot     = 45,
  border               = FALSE,
  rect_gp              = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "plain"),
    labels_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(2.5, "cm"),
    border        = NA
  )
)

# ── PANEL 3: TF activity per program (decoupleR) ──────────────────────────────

# Build and clean input matrix
cnmf_for_decoupler <- t(cnmf_scores_mat[cnmf_ids_clean, ])
colnames(cnmf_for_decoupler) <- bio_labels[cnmf_ids_clean]

message("NAs before cleaning:  ", sum(is.na(cnmf_for_decoupler)))
message("Infs before cleaning: ", sum(is.infinite(cnmf_for_decoupler)))

cnmf_for_decoupler[is.na(cnmf_for_decoupler)]       <- 0
cnmf_for_decoupler[is.infinite(cnmf_for_decoupler)] <- 0

# Remove all-zero rows
nonzero_rows       <- rowSums(abs(cnmf_for_decoupler)) > 0
cnmf_for_decoupler <- cnmf_for_decoupler[nonzero_rows, ]
message("Dims after cleaning: ", paste(dim(cnmf_for_decoupler), collapse = " x "))

# Load dorothea regulon
net <- dorothea_hs %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  dplyr::select(tf, target, mor) %>%
  dplyr::rename(source = tf)

# Run ULM
tf_act_programs <- run_ulm(
  mat     = cnmf_for_decoupler,
  net     = net,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "mor",
  minsize = 5
)

# Build output matrix
panel3_mat <- tf_act_programs %>%
  dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(source, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = score, values_fill = 0) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("source") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Clean output matrix
panel3_mat[is.na(panel3_mat)]       <- 0
panel3_mat[is.infinite(panel3_mat)] <- 0
panel3_mat <- panel3_mat[apply(panel3_mat, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), ]
panel3_mat <- panel3_mat[, apply(panel3_mat, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))]

message("Dims after cleaning: ", paste(dim(panel3_mat), collapse = " x "))

# Keep top variable TFs
tf_var     <- apply(panel3_mat, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
panel3_mat <- panel3_mat[tf_var > quantile(tf_var, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), ]

# Reorder columns to match program order
panel3_mat <- panel3_mat[, program_order[program_order %in% colnames(panel3_mat)]]

col_fun3 <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red"))

ht3 <- Heatmap(
  t(panel3_mat),
  name                 = "log2(fold change)",
  col                  = col_fun3,
  cluster_rows         = FALSE,
  cluster_columns      = TRUE,
  show_row_dend        = FALSE,
  show_column_dend     = FALSE,
  show_row_names       = FALSE,
  column_names_side    = "bottom",
  column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot     = 45,
  border               = FALSE,
  rect_gp              = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "plain"),
    labels_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(2.5, "cm"),
    border        = NA
  )
)

# ── COMBINE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pdf("./cNMF/cnmf_three_panel_heatmap.pdf", width = 16, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
draw(
  ht1 + ht2 + ht3,
  ht_gap      = unit(5, "mm"),
  padding     = unit(c(2, 2, 5, 2), "mm"),
  auto_adjust = FALSE
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
cnmf_cols_meta <- c(
  "Inflammation",
  "ECM remodeling",
  "Proliferating (M phase)",
  "Vascular remodeling",
  "Proliferating (S phase)",
  "Interferon Responsive"
)

# Map metadata names to display labels
bio_labels_meta <- c(
  "Inflammation"             = "Inflammatory SMC",
  "ECM remodeling"           = "ECM remodeling SMC",
  "Proliferating (M phase)"  = "Proliferating SMC (M phase)",
  "Vascular remodeling"      = "Vascular remodeling SMC",
  "Proliferating (S phase)"  = "Proliferating SMC (S phase)",
  "Interferon Responsive"    = "Interferon-stimulated SMC"
)

fmc_col <- "FMCScore1"

meta_sub <- sub@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(mixscape_class.global %in% c("KD", "NT")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PERTURB, mixscape_class.global, all_of(fmc_col), all_of(cnmf_cols_meta))

# ── PANEL A: Spearman correlation of each program with FMC score ──────────────

program_fmc_cor <- lapply(cnmf_cols_meta, function(prog) {
  ct <- cor.test(
    meta_sub[[prog]],
    meta_sub[[fmc_col]],
    method = "spearman",
    exact  = FALSE
  )
  data.frame(
    program     = prog,
    label       = bio_labels_meta[prog],
    rho         = ct$estimate,
    p.value     = ct$p.value,
    neg_log10_p = -log10(ct$p.value)
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rho))

print(program_fmc_cor)

pdf("./cNMF/cnmf_fmc_correlation.pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(program_fmc_cor,
       aes(x = reorder(label, rho), y = rho, fill = rho)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", "")),
            hjust = ifelse(program_fmc_cor$rho > 0, -0.3, 1.3),
            size  = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Spearman ρ with FMC score", fill = "ρ") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
dev.off()

# ── PANEL B: Per-perturbation scatter ─────────────────────────────────────────

# Top correlated program from metadata column names
top_program     <- program_fmc_cor$program[which.max(program_fmc_cor$rho)]
top_program_lab <- bio_labels_meta[top_program]

perturb_summary <- meta_sub %>%
  dplyr::filter(mixscape_class.global == "KD") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PERTURB) %>%

library(ggrepel)

pdf("./cNMF/cnmf_fmc_perturbation_scatter.pdf", width = 5, height = 4.5, useDingbats = FALSE)

    x     = "Mean FMC score",
    y     = paste0("Mean ", top_program_lab, " usage"),
    color = NULL,
    size  = "N cells"
  ) +

dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(fgsea)

# ── DEFINE UP/DOWN GENE SETS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

de_results <- readRDS("de_results_deseq2.rds")

# Zim3_3d3d = upregulated by stimulation
# Zim3_ctrl  = downregulated by stimulation (higher in control)

stim_up <- stim_de %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster == "Zim3_3d3d", p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

stim_down <- stim_de %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster == "Zim3_ctrl", p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

message(length(stim_up),   " stimulation-upregulated genes")
message(length(stim_down), " stimulation-downregulated genes")

# Build signed LFC vector for correlation analysis
stim_lfc_signed <- stim_de %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lfc_signed = ifelse(cluster == "Zim3_3d3d", avg_log2FC, -avg_log2FC)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(abs(lfc_signed), n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

stim_lfc_vec <- setNames(stim_lfc_signed$lfc_signed, stim_lfc_signed$gene)

# ── ANALYSIS 1: LFC vector correlation ───────────────────────────────────────

all_perturb_genes <- Reduce(union, lapply(de_results, function(x) if (!is.null(x)) x$gene))
shared_genes      <- intersect(names(stim_lfc_vec), all_perturb_genes)
message(length(shared_genes), " genes shared between stim DE and Perturb-seq DE")

lfc_correlations <- lapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)

  genes_use    <- intersect(shared_genes, res$gene)
  perturb_lfc  <- setNames(res$log2FoldChange, res$gene)[genes_use]
  stim_lfc_sub <- stim_lfc_vec[genes_use]

  keep         <- !is.na(perturb_lfc) & !is.na(stim_lfc_sub)
  perturb_lfc  <- perturb_lfc[keep]
  stim_lfc_sub <- stim_lfc_sub[keep]

  ct <- cor.test(perturb_lfc, stim_lfc_sub, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    PERTURB = pert,
    rho     = ct$estimate,
    p.value = ct$p.value,
    padj    = NA,
    type    = ifelse(grepl("_Enh", pert), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD"),
    n_genes = sum(keep)
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(rho))

print(lfc_correlations)

pdf("./stim_lfc_correlation.pdf", width = 5, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(lfc_correlations,
       aes(x = reorder(PERTURB, rho), y = rho, fill = type)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(padj < 0.05, "*", "")),
    hjust = ifelse(lfc_correlations$rho >= 0, -0.3, 1.3),
    size  = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x    = NULL,
    y    = "Spearman ρ with stimulated SMC LFC",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# ── ANALYSIS 4: FMC score vs Stim score correlation across cells ──────────────

cor_fmc_stim <- cor.test(sub$FMCScore1, sub$StimScore, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
message("FMC vs Stim: rho = ", round(cor_fmc_stim$estimate, 3),
        ", p = ",               signif(cor_fmc_stim$p.value, 3))

set.seed(42)
cells_plot <- sample(colnames(sub), min(10000, ncol(sub)))

  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("ρ = ", round(cor_fmc_stim$estimate, 2),
                          "\np = ", signif(cor_fmc_stim$p.value, 2)),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
  labs(x = "FMC score", y = "Stimulation score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9)
dev.off()

# ── ANALYSIS 5: 2D scatter — FMC score vs Stim score per perturbation ─────────

perturb_2d <- sub@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(mixscape_class.global == "KD") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PERTURB) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_fmc  = mean(FMCScore1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_stim = mean(StimScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells   = dplyr::n()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(grepl("_Enh", PERTURB), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD"))

library(ggrepel)

pdf("./fmc_stim_perturbation_2d.pdf", width = 5, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(perturb_2d,
       aes(x = mean_fmc, y = mean_stim, color = type, label = PERTURB)) +

  geom_point(aes(size = n_cells)) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2")) +

    x     = "Mean FMC score",
    y     = "Mean stimulation score",
    color = NULL,

  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
```

```{r}
library(RobustRankAggreg)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(ggrepel)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)

dir.create("./convergent", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ── STEP 1: RANK AGGREGATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

ranked_up <- lapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange), log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)
})
names(ranked_up) <- names(de_results)
ranked_up <- ranked_up[!sapply(ranked_up, is.null)]

ranked_down <- lapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj), !is.na(log2FoldChange), log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene)
})
names(ranked_down) <- names(de_results)
ranked_down <- ranked_down[!sapply(ranked_down, is.null)]

agg_up   <- aggregateRanks(ranked_up,   method = "RRA")
agg_down <- aggregateRanks(ranked_down, method = "RRA")

agg_up$direction   <- "Up"
agg_down$direction <- "Down"
agg_up$padj        <- p.adjust(agg_up$Score,   method = "BH")
agg_down$padj      <- p.adjust(agg_down$Score, method = "BH")

convergent_genes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  agg_up   %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Name),
  agg_down %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::rename(gene = Name)
) %>%
  # Deduplicate — keep direction with better RRA score
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(Score, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Score)

message(nrow(convergent_genes), " convergent genes identified")
print(head(convergent_genes, 20))
saveRDS(convergent_genes, "convergent_genes.rds")

# ── STEP 2: CONVERGENCE SCORE PER GENE ───────────────────────────────────────

top_genes_conv <- convergent_genes$gene[1:min(50, nrow(convergent_genes))]

convergence_counts <- lapply(top_genes_conv, function(g) {
  n_sig <- sum(sapply(de_results, function(res) {
    if (is.null(res)) return(FALSE)
    row <- res %>% dplyr::filter(gene == g)
    if (nrow(row) == 0) return(FALSE)
    !is.na(row$padj) && row$padj < 0.05
  }))
  data.frame(gene = g, n_perturbations = n_sig)
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    convergent_genes %>% dplyr::select(gene, direction, Score),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  # Deduplicate — keep dominant direction per gene
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(Score, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_perturbations))

print(head(convergence_counts, 20))

# ── STEP 3: BUILD LFC MATRIX ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

top_conv <- convergence_counts %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n_perturbations, n = 30) %>%
  dplyr::pull(gene)

lfc_conv_mat <- sapply(names(de_results), function(pert) {
  res <- de_results[[pert]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(rep(NA, length(top_conv)))
  lfc <- setNames(res$log2FoldChange, res$gene)
  lfc[top_conv]
})
rownames(lfc_conv_mat) <- top_conv
lfc_conv_mat[is.na(lfc_conv_mat)] <- 0

# ── STEP 4: PATHWAY ENRICHMENT ───────────────────────────────────────────────

msig_h  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
msig_go <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
gene_sets_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(msig_h, msig_go)

conv_up_genes   <- convergent_genes %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Up")   %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
conv_down_genes <- convergent_genes %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Down") %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
universe        <- Reduce(union, lapply(de_results, function(x) if (!is.null(x)) x$gene))

enrich_up <- enricher(
  gene         = conv_up_genes,
  universe     = universe,
  TERM2GENE    = gene_sets_df,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.2
)

enrich_down <- enricher(
  gene         = conv_down_genes,
  universe     = universe,
  TERM2GENE    = gene_sets_df,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.2
)

top_pathways_up <- if (!is.null(enrich_up)) {
  enrich_up@result %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = "Up", neg_log10 = -log10(p.adjust))
} else NULL

top_pathways_down <- if (!is.null(enrich_down)) {
  enrich_down@result %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = 10) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(direction = "Down", neg_log10 = -log10(p.adjust))
} else NULL

top_pathways <- dplyr::bind_rows(top_pathways_up, top_pathways_down)

# ── STEP 5: PANEL A — Convergence bar chart ───────────────────────────────────

conv_plot_data <- convergence_counts %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(n_perturbations, n = 25) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Up", "Down")),
    gene      = reorder(gene, n_perturbations)
  )

pA <- ggplot(conv_plot_data,
             aes(x = gene, y = n_perturbations, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#D62728", "Down" = "#1F77B4")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Number of perturbations",
    fill  = NULL,
    title = "Convergent gene program"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

pdf("./convergent/panelA_convergence_bar.pdf", width = 4, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(pA)
dev.off()

# ── STEP 6: PANEL B — LFC heatmap ────────────────────────────────────────────

col_fun_lfc <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#1F77B4", "white", "#D62728"))

# Row annotation — deduplicated direction per gene
row_dir <- convergence_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% top_conv) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, direction) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene")
row_dir <- row_dir[top_conv, , drop = FALSE]

# Column annotation
col_type <- data.frame(
  Type = ifelse(grepl("_Enh", colnames(lfc_conv_mat)), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD"),
  row.names = colnames(lfc_conv_mat)
)

row_annot <- rowAnnotation(
  Direction = row_dir$direction,
  col       = list(Direction = c("Up" = "#D62728", "Down" = "#1F77B4")),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  simple_anno_size     = unit(3, "mm")
)

col_annot <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Type = col_type$Type,
  col  = list(Type = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2")),
  simple_anno_size     = unit(3, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

htB <- Heatmap(
  lfc_conv_mat,
  name                 = "log2FC",
  col                  = col_fun_lfc,
  top_annotation       = col_annot,
  left_annotation      = row_annot,
  cluster_rows         = TRUE,
  cluster_columns      = TRUE,
  show_row_dend        = FALSE,
  show_column_dend     = FALSE,
  row_names_side       = "right",
  column_names_side    = "bottom",
  row_names_gp         = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  column_names_rot     = 45,
  border               = FALSE,
  rect_gp              = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    labels_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(2.5, "cm"),
    border        = NA
  )
)

pdf("./convergent/panelB_lfc_heatmap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
draw(htB, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm"))
dev.off()

# ── STEP 7: PANEL C — Pathway enrichment lollipop ────────────────────────────

pC <- ggplot(top_pathways,
             aes(x = reorder(Description, neg_log10),
                 y = neg_log10, color = direction)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = Description, yend = 0), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#D62728", "Down" = "#1F77B4")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "-log10(adjusted p)",
    color = NULL,
    size  = "Gene count",
    title = "Convergent program\npathway enrichment"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

pdf("./convergent/panelC_pathway_enrichment.pdf", width = 6, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(pC)
dev.off()

# ── STEP 8: UMAP + per-perturbation convergent score ─────────────────────────

DefaultAssay(sub) <- "RNA"
sub <- AddModuleScore(
  sub,
  features = list(conv_up_genes, conv_down_genes),
  name     = "ConvergentProgram"
)
sub$ConvergentScore <- sub$ConvergentProgram1 - sub$ConvergentProgram2

pdf("./convergent/umap_convergent_score.pdf", width = 5, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
FeaturePlot(sub,
            features  = "ConvergentScore",
            reduction = "ldaumap",
            order     = TRUE,
            cols      = c("#1F77B4", "white", "#D62728")) +
  ggtitle("Convergent CAD gene program score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
dev.off()

conv_score_summary <- sub@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(mixscape_class.global == "KD") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PERTURB) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_score = mean(ConvergentScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_score   = sd(ConvergentScore,  na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    n_cells    = dplyr::n()
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(grepl("_Enh", PERTURB), "Enhancer KD", "Gene KD")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_score))

pdf("./convergent/convergent_score_per_perturbation.pdf", width = 5, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot(conv_score_summary,
       aes(x = reorder(PERTURB, mean_score), y = mean_score, fill = type)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_score - se_score, ymax = mean_score + se_score),
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Gene KD" = "steelblue", "Enhancer KD" = "coral2")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean convergent program score", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
dev.off()
```
